<mxfile host="Electron" scale="0.65" border="15"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="fgkWyab_I-0wM23kDwcm"> <mxGraphModel dx="2097" dy="2032" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart TB

 %% ==========================================
 %% INSTITUTIONAL DOMAINS
 %% ==========================================

 subgraph ANANSE[\"ANANSE TELECOM — MOBILE MONEY\"]
 AN_CUSTOMER[\"Institutional Customer\"]
 WALLET[\"Wallet\"]
 TRANSACTION[\"Transaction\"]

 AN_CUSTOMER --- WALLET
 WALLET --- TRANSACTION
 end

 subgraph SIKA[\"SIKACREDIT — DIGITAL LENDING\"]
 SC_CUSTOMER[\"Institutional Customer\"]
 LOAN[\"Loan\"]
 REPAYMENT[\"Loan Repayment\"]

 SC_CUSTOMER --- LOAN
 LOAN --- REPAYMENT
 end

 subgraph OMAN[\"OMAN REMIT — REMITTANCE\"]
 OR_CUSTOMER[\"Institutional Customer\"]
 REMITTANCE[\"Remittance\"]
 RECIPIENT[\"Remittance Recipient\"]

 OR_CUSTOMER --- REMITTANCE
 REMITTANCE --- RECIPIENT
 end

 %% ==========================================
 %% OCB CUSTOMER IDENTITY RESOLUTION
 %% ==========================================

 subgraph IDENTITY[\"OCB CUSTOMER IDENTITY RESOLUTION\"]
 SOURCE_ID[\"Institution-Specific Customer Records\"]
 CUSTOMER[\"Canonical OCB Customer\"]
 IDENTITY_BRIDGE[\"Source Identity Bridge\"]

 SOURCE_ID --- IDENTITY_BRIDGE
 IDENTITY_BRIDGE --- CUSTOMER
 end

 AN_CUSTOMER -. \"Resolved identity\" .-> SOURCE_ID
 SC_CUSTOMER -. \"Resolved identity\" .-> SOURCE_ID
 OR_CUSTOMER -. \"Resolved identity\" .-> SOURCE_ID

 %% ==========================================
 %% OCB DATA AND INTELLIGENCE ARCHITECTURE
 %% ==========================================

 subgraph OCB[\"OCB FINANCIAL INTELLIGENCE PLATFORM\"]
 BRONZE[\"Bronze — Source Data\"]
 SILVER[\"Silver — Transformed Data and Identity Resolution\"]
 GOLD[\"Gold — Analytical Data Model\"]
 INTELLIGENCE[\"SQL Intelligence and Investigation Views\"]
 DASHBOARD[\"Supervisory and Institutional Monitoring Dashboard\"]

 BRONZE --> SILVER
 SILVER --> GOLD
 GOLD --> INTELLIGENCE
 INTELLIGENCE --> DASHBOARD
 end

 TRANSACTION --> BRONZE
 LOAN --> BRONZE
 REPAYMENT --> BRONZE
 REMITTANCE --> BRONZE

 CUSTOMER --> SILVER

 %% ==========================================
 %% GOVERNING PRINCIPLES
 %% ==========================================

 PRINCIPLES[\"OCB PRINCIPLES<br/><br/>
 Institutions remain operationally independent.<br/>
 Source records remain institution-specific.<br/>
 OCB resolves customer identities for analysis.<br/>
 Financial events retain their originating domain.<br/>
 Intelligence signals support investigation and supervision.<br/>
 Signals do not independently establish causation or misconduct.\"]

 INTELLIGENCE -.-> PRINCIPLES

 %% ==========================================
 %% MONOCHROME STYLING
 %% ==========================================

 classDef default fill:#FFFFFF,stroke:#000000,color:#000000
 classDef institution fill:#FFFFFF,stroke:#000000,color:#000000
 classDef source fill:#FFFFFF,stroke:#000000,color:#000000
 classDef identity fill:#FFFFFF,stroke:#000000,color:#000000
 classDef platform fill:#FFFFFF,stroke:#000000,color:#000000
 classDef principle fill:#FFFFFF,stroke:#000000,color:#000000

 class AN_CUSTOMER,WALLET,TRANSACTION,SC_CUSTOMER,LOAN,REPAYMENT,OR_CUSTOMER,REMITTANCE,RECIPIENT institution
 class SOURCE_ID,IDENTITY_BRIDGE source
 class CUSTOMER identity
 class BRONZE,SILVER,GOLD,INTELLIGENCE,DASHBOARD platform
 class PRINCIPLES principle",
 "config": null

OCB PRINCIPLES
Institutions remain operationally independent.
Source records remain institution-specific.
OCB resolves customer identities for analysis.
Financial events retain their originating domain.
Intelligence signals support investigation and supervision.
Signals do not independently establish causation or misconduct.
